name: token-tariff
description: Live LLM API cost calculator & model-comparison tool - compare prices and intelligence across every major model and pick the best value for your workload.

paragraphs: Token Tariff is an LLM API cost calculator. You describe your workload once, and it tells you what that workload would cost on every model and which model gives you the most capability for the money.
whether you care most about quality, price or speed, and get one recommended model with a cheaper and a more capable alternative beside it.
which models score as well or better, cheapest first.
features: RECOMMEND — "What should I use?" Pick a use case, adjust the workload, say
MATCH — "Can I get the same for less?" Name the model you use today and see
LOOK UP — "What does this model cost?" Search the whole catalog, including
Use-case presets. Chatbot, coding agent, agent, summarize and extraction.

Each one sets a typical workload size, which score to rank by (general intelligence, coding or agentic), a sensible range of model sizes, the capabilities you need, and your priorities. You can change anything…

whatItDoes.text: Token Tariff is an LLM API cost calculator. You describe your workload once, and it tells you what that workload would cost on every model and which model gives you the most capability for the money.

requirements.text: The cheap model must also cost no more than a tenth of Fable 5's price.
